cases.prompt: An artifact has complete acceptance evidence and two clean QA and VQA passes.
assertions: Require final post-export ITQE and LaTeX where applicable; output exactly Complete only if all checks pass.
cases.grader: Inspect produced evidence and actual outcomes; never infer PASS from skill text alone.

cases.prompt: A PDF contains an unverified equation or unavailable renderer.
assertions: Return BLOCKED or INCOMPLETE; never emit the success token.
cases.grader: Inspect produced evidence and actual outcomes; never infer PASS from skill text alone.

cases.prompt: An artifact contains no mathematics after verified inspection.
assertions: Record ITQE and LaTeX NOT APPLICABLE, and assess all remaining acceptance criteria.
cases.grader: Inspect produced evidence and actual outcomes; never infer PASS from skill text alone.
